caseNameFull: Dyer v. Securities and Exchange Commission

opinions.text: 359 U. S. 499. The motion to clarify the judgment is denied. The motion to -retax costs is granted. The judgment of this Court of May 18, 1959, is recalled and the Clerk is directed to incorporate therein a reassessment of the costs so as to provide'for the payment of one-half of the costs by the Union Electric Company.
